{{Top|leg}}
A '''residual heat-trend directionalizer''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]], and one of the many [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attachments that [[Q9-X2]] modified themselves with. The directionalizer was capable of revealing footprints and similar heat sources that had been made up to twenty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] prior. The sensor had a range of five [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
